data.title: The model behind the fence

memoryNodes.cue: A barrier separates visitors from the working area.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 障碍物将访客与施工区分开。

memoryNodes.cue: A damaged store will make room for a new entrance.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 受损的库房将腾出新入口的位置。

memoryNodes.cue: The dates describe the process of building.

data.situation:
At the marked entrance, Lin could see fences around the closed main building. Beyond them, debris from earlier work had been collected in a container. The visitors stayed in the open exhibition wing, where a model showed the proposed extension. A coloured arrow pointed to a small, damaged store that the team planned to demolish. Jo: Will the extension take the place of the store?
Architect: Partly. We plan to construct a new entrance there, with a room behind it. The model shows the footprint.
Lin: And when will the construction finish?
Architect: The timetable is beside the model. These dates are our current plan; the centre will post changes at the entrance. Main building closed
Please stay on the marked visitor route. The fences separate the exhibition entrance from the construction area. The model inside shows the proposed new rooms.

readingBlocks.en: At the marked entrance, Lin could see fences around the closed main building. Beyond them, debris from earlier work had been collected in a container. The visitors stayed in the open exhibition wing, where a model showed the proposed extension. A coloured arrow pointed to a small, damaged store that the team planned to demolish.
readingBlocks.zh: 在标出的入口，林能看见关闭的主楼周围的围挡。围挡后，先前施工留下的碎料已收集进一个容器。访客留在开放的展览翼楼，那里有模型展示拟建扩建部分。一支彩色箭头指向团队计划拆除的一间受损小库房。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: Will the extension take the place of the store?
Architect: Partly. We plan to construct a new entrance there, with a room behind it. The model shows the footprint.
Lin: And when will the construction finish?
Architect: The timetable is beside the model. These dates are our current plan; the centre will post changes at the entrance.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：扩建部分会代替库房吗？
建筑师：部分会。我们计划在那里修建新入口，后面设一个房间。模型显示占地范围。
林：建造什么时候结束？
建筑师：时间表在模型旁，这些日期是目前的计划；如果有变化，中心会在入口张贴。

Main building closed
Please stay on the marked visitor route. The fences separate the exhibition entrance from the construction area. The model inside shows the proposed new rooms.

主楼关闭
请沿标出的参观路线行走。围挡把展览入口与施工区域分开，屋内模型展示拟建的新房间。

glossary.zh: 围住或隔开一片区域的栅栏、围挡
glossary.note: fence/fences；复数为同一单位的词形。

externalEvidence.definition: a barrier that serves to enclose an area

glossary.zh: 损坏或施工等留下的碎片与残料
glossary.note: 不可数集合名词；不用a debris。
glossary.example: The debris has been collected in a container.

externalEvidence.definition: the remains of something that has been destroyed or broken up

glossary.zh: 给既有建筑增加的部分；扩建部分
glossary.note: a building extension；本例不是延期或电话号码分机。
glossary.example: The model shows the proposed extension.
glossary.exampleZh: 模型显示拟建的扩建部分。

externalEvidence.definition: an addition that extends a main building

glossary.note: demolish a building；宾语是建筑或结构。
glossary.example: They plan to demolish the damaged store.
glossary.exampleZh: 他们计划拆除受损库房。

glossary.example: They plan to construct a new entrance.

externalEvidence.definition: make by combining materials and parts

glossary.note: construction work/the construction of something；本例过程义。
glossary.example: Lin asks when the construction will finish.
glossary.exampleZh: 林询问建造工程何时完成。
